input.question: Which award did Manuel Estrada Pérez receive?

documents.text:
**Breaking News: Spanish Graphic Designer Manuel Estrada Pérez Honored with Prestigious Finnish Award**

In a remarkable recognition of his outstanding contributions to the field of graphic design, Spanish designer Manuel Estrada Pérez has been bestowed with the esteemed title of Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland. This prestigious award, conferred by the Finnish government, is a testament to Pérez's exceptional talent and dedication to his craft. According to the Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Order of the White Rose of Finland is a high honor awarded to individuals who have made significant contributions to the promotion of Finnish culture, science, and art. The award is presented by the President of Finland and is considered one of the country's highest civilian honors. "We are thrilled to recognize Manuel Estrada Pérez's outstanding achievements in graphic design," said Ambassador of Finland to Spain, H.E. Tiina Jortikka-Laitinen. "His work has not only showcased Finnish design excellence but has also fostered greater cultural understanding between our nations." Pérez, a renowned graphic designer from Spain, has made a significant impact in the industry with his innovative and visually stunning designs. His work has been featured in numerous international exhibitions and publications, earning him widespread acclaim and respect from his peers. "I am deeply humbled and grateful to receive this prestigious award," said Manuel Estrada Pérez in an exclusive interview. "It is an honor to be recognized by the Finnish government, and I am proud to have had the opportunity to contribute to the promotion of Finnish culture and design." Data from the Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs reveals that only a select few individuals from around the world are awarded the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland each year. This exclusive group includes notable figures from the fields of art, science, and culture, making Pérez's achievement all the more remarkable. In conclusion, Manuel Estrada Pérez's receipt of the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland is a testament to his exceptional talent and dedication to the field of graphic design. This prestigious award serves as a beacon of recognition for his outstanding contributions to the promotion of Finnish culture and design. **Sources:**

* Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs
* Embassy of Finland in Spain
* Manuel Estrada Pérez (exclusive interview)
* H.E.

accepted_answers: Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland
